autoCompleteNotReady: Available when stock and waste are empty
playing: Play divan and waste cards onto the foundations

tutorial.stockWaste: Click the stock to draw one card. When the stock runs out you may redeal the waste, up to twice.
tutorial.foundation: Build 8 King-based foundations up by suit: King → Ace → 2 … 10 → Jack → Queen.
tutorial.divan: The 8-slot Divan reserve feeds the foundations. A played slot refills automatically from the stock. Click a divan or waste card to play it.
tutorial.controls: Use redeal, hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.

frontendHint.sultanMove: This card goes onto a foundation
